name: home-assistant-connector
description: Reusable Home Assistant connector with per-category Disabled/Enabled/Verify permissions, secure Anna APS approval queue, PIN/TOTP verification, WebAuthn passkey support where permitted, and optional phone notification links.
author: Eric McCormick

credentials.name: HA_URL
credentials.description: HTTPS base URL, e.g. https://example.home:8123. No path or slash after port.

credentials.name: HA_TOKEN
credentials.description: Create in Home Assistant profile. Never share in a conversation.

credentials.name: HA_ALLOW_LOCAL_HTTP
credentials.description: Set true ONLY on a trusted local Agent/LAN. Token will travel unencrypted.

credentials.name: HA_POLICY_JSON
credentials.description: Nonsecret policy JSON. Modes: disabled, enabled, verify; all except sensors disabled by default. Legacy pin means verify.

credentials.name: HA_APPROVAL_PIN
credentials.description: Sensitive native credential; required for PIN approvals and passkey enrollment. Never enter into Anna chat or another app.

credentials.name: HA_TOTP_SECRET
credentials.description: Optional RFC6238 SHA-1 authenticator seed, configured only in Executa native credentials. Do not put in chat or App persistent storage.

credentials.name: HA_PHONE_NOTIFY_SERVICE
credentials.description: Optional Home Assistant notification service name such as mobile_app_pixel_10_pro (without notify. prefix). Notifications alert but do NOT approve.

credentials.name: HA_APPROVAL_LINK
credentials.description: HTTPS anna.partners App window link, if known. Only used in phone notification Open action.

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description: Show active permissions and configured verification methods.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read one entity. Use compact for current state; omit for attributes and timestamps. Non-sensors require other_read.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List entities by domain. Use compact for current states. Non-sensors require other_read.

tools.name: converse
tools.description: Ask Home Assistant Assist. Requires assist permission and may control devices indirectly.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Run an allowed service or queue exact-action verification. Verify requires user approval.

tools.name: fire_event
tools.description: Fire an allowed event or queue verification.

tools.name: begin_passkey_enrollment
tools.description: Start passkey enrollment in Control Center. Never ask for a PIN in chat.

tools.name: finish_passkey_enrollment
tools.description: Complete passkey enrollment from Control Center.

tools.name: begin_passkey_approval
tools.description: Get a passkey challenge for a pending action in Control Center.

tools.name: approve_action
tools.description: Verify and execute the exact stored action once. Use Control Center only; never collect codes in chat.
